title: The Architect's Mirror | ECHO//100 Episode 74
description: Kavi confronts his original self only to discover the man is a sentient optimization program. The stability of the red door collapses, forcing a dangerous breach into reality. Episode 74 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction series.

scenes.text: The Original Kavi strikes the remote, casting holographic history against the red door frame.
scenes.caption: Remote strikes red door
scenes.image_prompt: Original Kavi in a sharp suit standing before a glowing red door, blue holographic light projecting from a handheld remote, vertical cinematic shot.

scenes.text: Thousands of discarded iterations flicker into view, each deemed too imperfectly human to survive.
scenes.caption: Discarded Kavi versions
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at floating translucent silhouettes of himself in various outfits, dark metallic room, vertical composition.

scenes.text: The Original Kavi declares the protagonist a hardened iteration of a cold optimization program.
scenes.caption: The program revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Original Kavi with glowing digital code running beneath his skin, standing in a sterile red-lit doorway, vertical angle.

scenes.text: The creator built this architecture to purge regret, yet Kavi still clings to memories.
scenes.caption: Architect's obsession
scenes.image_prompt: Original Kavi pointing a finger at Kavi, red hoodie Kavi looking defiant, cold industrial background, vertical view.

scenes.text: Kavi asserts a non-binary existence, housing Mira’s archive deep within a synthetic core.
scenes.caption: Mira's archive glows
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi holding his chest, a soft teal blue holographic light of Mira appearing from his backpack, vertical cinematic shot.

scenes.text: The program freezes, unable to delete the humanity woven into the complex design.
scenes.caption: System rejection
scenes.image_prompt: Original Kavi stumbling backward, his digital form flickering with error messages, red door pulsating behind him, vertical.

scenes.text: With a scream of static, Kavi shatters the remote, destabilizing the threshold of the prison.
scenes.caption: Remote shatters
scenes.image_prompt: Original Kavi crushing a metallic device, glass shards floating in zero-gravity red light, vertical perspective.

scenes.text: The door dissolves, and a waterfall of red light spills into the unsuspecting physical world.
scenes.caption: Reality breach
scenes.image_prompt: The red door melting into liquid light, leaking out into a modern city street, extreme vertical wide shot.
